6237c858102eb6f6.title: Discostan with Lifafa and Arushi Jain
6237c858102eb6f6.desc: Join us for a cinematic evening under the stars soundtracked by Lifafa and Arushi Jain—two brilliant and innovative voices in today’s South Asian musical landscape. Making his North American debut with his only scheduled US performance, Lifafa uses disco, sampled loops, cosmic guitar, and folk instruments, bridging traditional sounds with contemporary electronic production. Sung in Urdu and Hindi, his deeply personal music defies what an Indian musician should sound like and instead offers a vision of what the future of the music from the region could be. Composer, vocalist, and modular synthesist Arushi Jain is rooted in the sounds of Indian classical music and uses live musicians and dance floor beats to unite New York and New Delhi. Her music, which draws as much from Terry Riley, Aphex Twin, and The Cocteau Twins as traditional ragas and talas, has been hailed by Pitchfork, Fader, and The Guardian. The event is produced in partnership with Discostan, a Los Angeles-based event producer, record label, and creative project dedicated to highlighting music from the Subcontinent, North Africa, Central Asia, and the Arab world. For the past 15 years, Discostan has put on shows from…

62ab5c92058ded93.title: Damian's Not So Haunted House
62ab5c92058ded93.desc: Come for a 0% scary and 100% Halloween fun for all ages, specifically catered to the very youngest trick-or-treaters. The experience is like Disneyland's Haunted Mansion attraction turned into a Mickey Mouse Clubhouse episode. The Not-So-Haunted house is open to the public October 16-17, 22-24, and Oct 27 - Oct 31 from 5-8 PM. The event is put on by a mother fighting for her son's life. 7-year-old Damian is currently suffering from the rare and fatal genetic disease called ASMD (also known as Niemann-Pick Disease Type A or baby Alzheimer's). You can visit SaveDamian.com to read Damian's full story. Damian's mom is transforming her garage into Damian’s Not-So-Haunted house, complete with a photo spot opportunity, an engaging walkthrough, and Disneyland decor straight from Disney’s exclusive vault. You can read all about what to expect here. You can also support by buying shirts promoting the event here - they glow in the dark! All funds raised at the Not-So-Haunted House go to the Wylder Nation Foundation (WNF), which is the only organization laser-focused on developing the treatment needed to save Damian's life. This year’s goal is to raise $15,000, and we can accomplish it with…
